## Documentation Issue Type

- [ ] Outdated or inaccurate information
- [ ] Missing documentation or examples

## Location

Where is the documentation issue located?

- [ ] `README.md`
- [ ] `CLAUDE.md` / `GEMINI.md`

- [ ] Code comments / docstrings
- [ ] CLI `--help` output
- [ ] Other: ***
